# Vendored Snowball (BSD-3-Clause)

Generated JavaScript from the Snowball stemmer compiler. Do not edit by hand.

- Source: https://github.com/snowballstem/snowball, tag `v3.1.1`
  (commit `cd195b51e948a902a4312f023f4a14392516a543`, 2026-06-03).
- `persian-stemmer.js`: `./snowball algorithms/persian.sbl -js -o persian-stemmer`
- `base-stemmer.js`: copied from `javascript/base-stemmer.js` at the same commit.
- License: `COPYING` (BSD-3-Clause).

To regenerate: clone the tag, `make snowball`, run the command above, copy both files.
